title: First post here.... sharing my roguelite, Ascendence
author: papieternaL
selftext:
Sup all! this is my first post here, so I wanted to share a recent update from my game **Ascendence**.

It’s a 2D roguelite/survivor-style game I’ve been building, and I’ve been using AI pretty heavily in the workflow — mostly for concept art, VFX direction, sprite/animation experiments, and helping speed up iteration while I build things out in Godot.

This latest video shows the newest weapon/hero I’m working on: **Necrotic Staff**, inspired by warlocks/necromancers.

  
[https://x.com/papieternaL/status/2064115150106267893?s=20](https://x.com/papieternaL/status/2064115150106267893?s=20)

The kit currently revolves around:

* applying Decay/Skull Marks to enemies
* summoning skeletal warriors
* using Gravebind to control groups
* draining life from marked enemies with the ultimate

You’ll also see a map objective happening in the video, which I’m using to give runs more structure beyond just clearing waves.

A lot of the art and animation is still rough, but I’ve been experimenting with GPT Image 2, animation pipelines, and community tools to get the game closer visually. It’s not perfect yet, but it’s been a big improvement from where it started.... If you want to follow the journey I'll be putting together a small playtest soon on the current iteration and would love to gather some feedback!

comments.author: WideDonkey4787
comments.body: I got you followed and I'm interested to see where this project goes!

replies.author: papieternaL
replies.body: Appreciate the support! It’s mainly a portfolio piece and I really want to see how far I can push codex into game development!
